text:
kevin-partners: Heads-up: Azure marketplace metering delta spike after the Germany region failover this morning. Some subscriptions show entitlements not matching usage. attaching logs shortly.

maria-ops: saw it in the dashboards — latency + retry storms around 02:14 UTC. looks like duplicate usage lines from the failover window.

tim-eng: can you paste a sample event that mismatched? need to see the event_id/account_id combo.

kevin-partners: sure — example from the export:
```
{"event_id":"evt_84a3","customer_id":"cust_773","region":"eu-central-1-secondary","sku":"dedicated_gpu_hours","quantity":10,"timestamp":"2026-03-15T02:14:23Z","entitlement_snapshot_version":"v12"}
```
This got ingested alongside the primary region line for the same window.

jen-support: we've got 6 tickets already, two customers flagged unexpected surcharges. one is an SI partner billing their end customers.

sarah-engr: probable root cause: when the active region flipped, downstream metering emitted retried events without preserved idempotency keys, and our rollup job used the entitlement snapshot from the old source. leads to double-counting for the case where entitlement lookups returned slightly different plan ids.

alex-bizdev: which marketplaces / partners are affected? do we need to notify hardware partners (they bill by GPU time) or just cloud marketplace teams?

kevin-partners: primarily Azure EU-C, a handful of customers on Marketplace private offers. Some hardware partners (OEM GPU partners) surfaced as they consume our billed metrics for cost pass-through.

marketplace-bot: automated-report: affected_subscriptions=42; estimated_delta_usd=12345.67; earliest_affected_ts=2026-03-15T02:14:00Z; latest_affected_ts=2026-03-15T02:20:00Z

maria-ops: action items I propose: 1) block the current rollup job, 2) run a dedupe + reconciliation on the raw event stream (idempotency key = customer_id + sku + window + event_id), 3) generate per-partner delta CSVs for accounting and partner ops.

tim-eng: I can push a small hotfix to the reconciliation job to prefer event_id-based dedupe and re-run historical window for the 6-minute span. will add unit tests for idempotency key calc.

partner-ops: please include SI contact list; we'll need to coordinate communications and potential credits.

kevin-partners: I'll draft a short partner note: "We detected duplicated usage from a regional failover; we're reconciling and will provide detailed deltas + credits where appropriate. ETA for CSVs: 6 hours." Any objections?

jen-support: please cc support@redwood and include a standard credit policy blurb.

sarah-engr: also: add a postmortem item to harden the entitlement snapshot logic — entitlement lookups should be canonicalized by customer id + offer id, not region-assigned snapshot tags.

tim-eng: agreed. I'll open the PR and the backfill job now. Will post the backfill job id when scheduled.

kevin-partners: thanks — please tag me and partner-ops when the CSVs are ready. I'll lead partner comms. :thumbsup:

marketplace-bot: job-schedule: reconciliation-backfill-1799100450 scheduled by tim-eng; ticket-ref=#BILL-4283

maria-ops: monitoring note: created alert rule 'marketplace.dup-usage-spike' for faster detection on failovers.

kevin-partners: perfect. follow-up: we should loop in legal for SI enterprise contracts if delta > $50k for any single partner. I'll escalate if needed.

kevin-partners: (closing) plan is: hotfix dedupe -> run backfill -> produce partner CSVs -> notify partners + support -> run postmortem. I'll post updates in this thread.
